value.rationale: The result provides a falsifiable, exact sparse observation scheduling criterion (a mixed-contrast cycle in each component), an exceptional-data characterization and a sharp m+n depth budget for separating wavelength-dependent planetary transit depth from time-dependent cool-spot contamination. Neither a parameter count alone nor photometric monitoring heuristics determine which incomplete observation calendars recover all unknowns; the cyclic contrast structure is the substantive measurement-design gap.
